BUSINESS STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   B. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   D. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   B. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   D. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

8. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   B. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   B. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.

11. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

13. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

15. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   D. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Trial Balance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
